en.headline: Wang Fuk Court acceptance climbs to 97.7 per cent ahead of deadline
en.dek: As of noon on Sunday 1,939 of 1,984 owners had returned acceptance letters, leaving about 45 households; the Housing Bureau urged the remainder to act by 5pm Monday.
body: The Housing Bureau said on Sunday that 97.7 per cent of Wang Fuk Court owners—1,939 households across the eight blocks—had returned signed letters of acceptance for the government’s acquisition offer by noon. Formal sale and purchase agreements had been signed with 1,541 households, or 77.7 per cent.
That left roughly 45 owners, or 2.3 per cent, yet to accept before the 5pm Monday deadline. The figure represents a further rise from the 96.5 per cent reported on Friday.

A bureau spokesman urged the remaining owners not to miss the final opportunity and to return the signed letter of acceptance by the cut-off. Engagement teams continued to contact holdouts and offer assistance with submission by hand, post or courier.

Under the scheme the government will acquire flats at HK$8,000 or HK$10,500 per square foot of saleable area, depending on whether land premium has been paid. Owners who sell may later join a special sales exercise for subsidised flats or purchase on the open market.
The acquisition follows the November 2025 fire that killed 168 people and displaced thousands of residents at the Tai Po estate.

zh.headline: 宏福苑業主接受收購比率升至97.7% 尚餘約45戶
zh.dek: 截至周日中午，1,984戶中有1,939戶已交回接受書，房屋局呼籲餘下業主於周一傍晚5時前把握最後機會。
body: 房屋局周日表示，截至當日中午，宏福苑八座合共1,984戶業主中，已有1,939戶（97.7%）交回已簽署的接受書，另有1,541戶（77.7%）已簽訂買賣協議。
尚餘約45戶（2.3%）未接受政府收購建議，距離周一傍晚5時截止期限僅餘一天。數字較周五公布的96.5%進一步上升。
局方發言人呼籲仍未回覆的業主把握最後機會，於截止前交回已簽署的接受書。聯絡團隊會繼續接觸相關業主，並協助以親身、郵寄或速遞方式提交文件。
按收購方案，政府將以實用面積每平方呎8,000元或10,500元（視乎是否已補地價）購入單位。出售後業主可參與特別銷售計劃揀選資助房屋，或在公開市場置業。
是次收購源於2025年11月宏福苑大火，事件造成168人死亡，並令數千名居民流離失所。
